rules.rationale: ESOL: long SMILES lowered solubility (-11.46); inverting gives higher logD for large carbon-rich scaffolds.
Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); small molecules are hydrophilic, low partition coefficient.
Ring role had highest transfer weight (0.758); fused ring surface resists hydration and favors octanol.
Donor-to-heteroatom mapping implies hydrogen bonding and polar solvation, reducing octanol-water partitioning.

skills.hypothesis: Retains the source-grounded solubility inversion on size and ring roles with faster hand-off to the target anchor. Fails if large target molecules are polar or ionizable, breaking the inversion.

rules.rationale: Extended aromatic systems bury large nonpolar surface, a dominant positive term in logD models.
Fully aliphatic, non-aromatic molecules here are typically small polar solutes with low partitioning.
Branch role transferred strongly (0.758); alkyl branching shields polar centers and adds hydrophobic bulk.
Counter-hypothesis: low-confidence (0.22) length role may not invert; very long molecules are often multi-polar.

skills.hypothesis: Uses broad-coverage aromatic and branch descriptors instead of the rare halogen_high bin, while downweighting the uncertain length transfer. Fails if aromatic bulk here co-occurs with strongly polar substituents.

state.lesson: Both prior skills reached similar mean AUC, but the inversion skill gave higher mean final best; rare-bin rules (halogen_high, 98 of 4200) contribute little surrogate signal, so replacing them with broad-coverage aromatic and branch features is a safer counter-hypothesis.
state.revision_summary: Kept the source-grounded inversion skill with mildly reduced semantic mass and prior scale to hand off sooner to the target-only anchor. Rebuilt the counter-hypothesis around high-coverage aromatic and branch bins, dropping the sparse halogen rules that could not inform the surrogate, while retaining the explicit downweight of the low-confidence length transfer. All conditions map exact catalog fields to exact catalog values; deployment frozen on the inversion skill.
